officialTitle: Osimertinib in Resected EGFR-Mutated Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer

design.sampleSizeSourceQuote: A total of 682 patients underwent randomization (339 to the osimertinib group and 343 to the placebo group).

clinicalQuestion: Does adjuvant osimertinib improve outcomes after complete resection of EGFR-mutated stage IB–IIIA NSCLC?

pico.population: Completely resected EGFR mutation-positive stage IB–IIIA NSCLC, with or without prior adjuvant chemotherapy
pico.intervention: Osimertinib 80 mg once daily for up to 3 years
pico.outcomes: Primary: DFS in stage II–IIIA. Secondary: DFS in stage IB–IIIA, CNS DFS, OS, safety

arms.label: Osimertinib
arms.doseSourceQuote: osimertinib (80 mg once daily) or placebo for 3 years

publications.title: Osimertinib in Resected-Mutated Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer.
publications.label: Primary DFS analysis

publications.title: Overall Survival with Osimertinib in Resected-Mutated NSCLC.
publications.label: Final overall survival analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: At 24 months, 90% of the patients with stage II to IIIA disease in the osimertinib group (95% confidence interval [CI], 84 to 93) and 44% of those in the placebo group (95% CI, 37 to 51) were alive and disease-free (overall hazard ratio for disease recurrence or death, 0.17; 99.06% CI, 0.11 to 0.26; P<0.001).

In the overall population, 89% of the patients in the osimertinib group (95% CI, 85 to 92) and 52% of those in the placebo group (95% CI, 46 to 58) were alive and disease-free at 24 months (overall hazard ratio for disease recurrence or death, 0.20; 99.12% CI, 0.14 to 0.30; P<0.001).

At 24 months, 98% of the patients in the osimertinib group (95% CI, 95 to 99) and 85% of those in the placebo group (95% CI, 80 to 89) were alive and did not have central nervous system disease (overall hazard ratio for disease recurrence or death, 0.18; 95% CI, 0.10 to 0.33).

Among patients with stage II to IIIA disease, the 5-year overall survival was 85% in the osimertinib group and 73% in the placebo group (overall hazard ratio for death, 0.49; 95.03% confidence interval [CI], 0.33 to 0.73; P<0.001).

In the overall population (patients with stage IB to IIIA disease), the 5-year overall survival was 88% in the osimertinib group and 78% in the placebo group (overall hazard ratio for death, 0.49; 95.03% CI, 0.34 to 0.70; P<0.001).

strengths: Both DFS and final OS benefit demonstrated
limitations: Placebo control rather than active comparator
Prior adjuvant chemotherapy optional and not randomised
Optimal treatment duration beyond the protocol period not addressed

clinicalImplications.text: Established adjuvant osimertinib after complete resection (with or without adjuvant chemotherapy) for EGFR-mutated stage IB–IIIA NSCLC, making EGFR testing of resected non-squamous tumours essential.

tumourBoardPearl.text: Test resected tumours for EGFR before adjuvant planning — ADAURA showed both a DFS and an OS benefit, including fewer CNS recurrences.
